newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest shares sag, turnover slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest shares sag, turnover slightly up.

text.p: The bulk of Bucharest stock prices drifted further down in thin investor interest on Tuesday, sending two unofficial indexes to record lows.
"Investors are keen on seeing newcomers. This waiting mood pulled prices lower and kept volumes thin," a trader said.
Volume was some 16,000 shares on turnover of 77.4 million lei, a modest 15 million up from the previous level. Three stocks had no trade.
The exchange said last week 11 companies had applied for listing but did not say when they would join in trading.

It also said it would soon handle public offerings for 14 state companies, including the national travel operator ONT Carpati SA and the country's only newsprint maker Letea SA, whose shares would be subsequently traded on the exchange.
The bourse now trades 13 of the 16 listed stocks.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker dominated Tuesday, taking 61 percent of turnover. It closed 450 lei down at 9,750.

"Azomures' price was virtually set in the last two or three minutes of the session, with one share owner willing to sell at the lower price anticipating further falls next session," said another trader.
Engineer Artrom SA, with half the total traded shares, also took centre stage: "Artrom did well but its price is too low to influence turnover level," one broker said.
Artrom closed Tuesday 200 lei weaker at 2,000.
The unofficial VAB and BIG value-weighted indexes of all listed stocks, computed by Vanguard SA securities and Bucharest Investment Group respectively, fell to year lows.
The VAB was 4.9 percent down from the previous session to 296.3 points and the BIG dropped 4.68 percent to 294.68 points.
Prices are on MRRO and MRRP.
